loader_handoff.basis: Declared discovery input: an all-zero loader handoff in a free RAM gap, not a capture. The kernel copies 0x5c0 bytes from it; the boot-reason word at +0x140 reads zero, whose meaning is untraced. Kernel entry bypasses the boot ROM.

flash_aperture.basis: Declared discovery input: the update image from its flash offset; bytes past it read erased. No flash capture exists.
